cases.rationale: Correct primary HbA1c and secondary FPG/2hPG outcomes; replace this meta-analysis with an explicit He et al. identity. Useful retrieval floor, not a reasoning case.
Eight trials/725 participants is supported, but distinguish the 196 participants/two trials in the primary change-score analysis; supply study identity.
Supported null HbA1c change-score estimate -1.92 percentage points, CI -4.43 to 0.59, P=.13; preserve two-trial/196-person denominator, exploratory secondary findings and very-low certainty.

Primary and sensitivity estimates are supported; require separate result locations and the reason post-treatment values are only supportive. Do not equate statistical significance with a reliable clinical benefit.
All outcomes very-low certainty and downgrade reasons occur together in Certainty of evidence. Label direct lookup unless a separately located primary-analysis denominator is required.
S1-S3 random-number tables supported; allocation concealment unreported and all trials judged high risk of bias. Random sequence reporting alone does not establish overall low bias.

Main PDF does not name the metformin brand; it directs dose/regimen detail to excluded Appendix S3. Keep only as explicitly main-PDF-scoped absent fact after expanded-corpus review; do not infer absence from all original trial publications.

Ambiguous general HbA1c/complication question does not uniquely require Raman. Several reviews discuss that relationship. Removed epidemiology source; rebuild around a named cohort/outcome/adjusted estimate and genuine competing passage.
Raman CC BY 2.0 fails exact-version policy. Reported adjusted 73.3% CI 73.2-73.3 is unusually narrow; preserve as reported rather than repair. New cohort cannot inherit Indian estimates.
First morning microalbuminuria ACR 30-299 mg/g supported in Raman Definitions; not a universal DKD diagnostic rule. Rebuild only with replacement-specific definition.

IDF definition supported; gold omits 90/80 cm waist values. Source prints an apparent triglyceride unit error (150 mg/l), which must not be silently harmonized. Replace with eligible source-specific definition.
Sex-specific duration trend supported but table bins 0-10/11-20/>20 differ from prose <10/10-20/>20; do not pretend exact bin equality. Cross-sectional trend is not longitudinal within-person change.

Table 7 nephropathy HbA1c/duration/hypertension and neuropathy HDL/waist associations supported. Co-located table comparison is weak multi-hop; adjustment/direction/unit binding needed. Removed source.
30-40% is a cited review estimate, not an incidence measured by Lebedeva et al. Add review identity and prevent mixing prevalence/incident risk across populations.
Renal hypoxia described as fundamental mechanism; add review identity and preserve mechanistic/preclinical framing rather than imply proved treatment efficacy.
ZnT8 insulin-granule role and largely pancreatic-islet expression supported locally. Later renal ZnT8 discussion qualifies simplistic pancreas-only inference; add section-specific scope.

Zinc proteasomal degradation/nuclear exclusion and animal fibrosis findings are co-located on PDF page 12, so current multi-hop label overstates separation. Preserve may/preclinical scope and distinguish adaptive acute from pathological chronic HIF activity.
ZnT7 and ZnT8 findings are co-located on page 11. Preserve different experimental contexts and pathway attribution; use direct comparison unless requiring another separate section.

Mechanistic hypoxia evidence supported but generic question has valid alternative mechanistic reviews; removed Raman cannot remain a selected distractor. Scope to Lebedeva and compare adaptive versus sustained HIF signalling or a genuine competing clinical endpoint.

Restricted GWAS excluded. Male association and P=.035 versus female P=.40 do not alone prove a sex interaction; avoid confirming male-specific causality from unequal stratum significance. Replace drug-response and sex-specific behaviours separately.
Male h2=.87 SE .22 P=4.9e-5 and female h2=.01 SE .44 P=.50 are reported. Imprecision/stratum sample size must accompany any sex-difference interpretation. Removed source; values cannot migrate.

Source conflict: abstract/Table 1 report 871 total (520 male/351 female); Common variant analysis states 870/520/350. Original answer hides this conflict. No invented exclusion explanation; retire with excluded source.

PMET1 replication plus SUGAR-MGH acute response are distinct evidence locations. Observational genetic/acute insulin associations are supportive follow-up, not proof of mechanism or dosing utility. Rebuild around eligible evidence.

Generic KATP/calcium question is answerable by the zinc review alone; current question does not demand attributed complementary facts from both papers. Gold copies GWAS potassium influx wording; do not endorse as established physiology. New synthesis must explicitly require distinct article-specific facts.
NHW/NHB P=.0013 and NHW/Hispanic P=.14 supported but ancestry/race covariate association is not genetic causality. Restricted source excluded; preserve population differentiation in another case.
102 studies and narrative/non-PRISMA method supported; no prospective intermediate screening counts. Explicit review identity and no systematic-review claim.

Review attributes 48% heart-disease and 15% stroke increased developing/dying risk to pooled longitudinal evidence. Question incorrectly singles out MI and a single large study; revise to review-attributed heart-disease endpoints, not new primary-trial evidence.

Leproult 16 healthy non-obese adults: no overall glucose/insulin change, correlations with sleep extension reported. Avoid equating positive glucose correlation with desirable glucose reduction or calling a correlation an intervention effect size.

Appetite/endocannabinoid and cortisol/glucose mechanisms require separate review locations. Frame as reviewed mechanisms from different cited experiments, not proof that one hormonal change caused every reported endpoint.

2.96/2.63/2.27 review-attributed macrovascular risks supported; current generic evidence-reviewed question can accept alternatives. Explicitly identify review/cited cohort; use eligible prevalence paper as competing population/outcome evidence.

Review reports day-specific spring/fall MI changes and no weekly PCI-for-MI change; original wording omits weekly null result and location is stale. Preserve reviewed observational/natural-experiment scope and conflicting literature caveat.

FAISS, 500/100 characters, text-embedding-3-small, top_k=2 and L2 supported. Name Guo CGM counseling study; its RAG architecture does not establish patient outcomes. Original note that any unrelated returned chunk proves a pipeline problem is too absolute.

Estimated .782-point difference, CI .692-.872, P<.001 supported; means 4.37/3.58 are vignette ratings, not clinical superiority. Preserve scaffolded CA versus usual written clinician response asymmetry.
Empathy 1.062 and actionability .992 are supported. Largest rating differences do not demonstrate intrinsic empathy or better patient outcomes; useful labelled dimension binding.

797 definitive judgments versus all 864 ratings is essential: 87.5% versus 80.7% correct overall, 67 unsure. Results/Limitations support imperfect practical masking and familiarity bias, not a causal source-bias estimate. Require separate result and limitation anchors.
